  - Warm coats and jackets
  - Insulating layers
  - Warm socks and gloves
  - Scarf, hat, and earmuffs
  - Warm pants and leggings
  - Dress for layers
  - Warm and waterproof boots
  - Slippers
  - Moisturizer
  - Lip balm
  - Power adapter
  - Travel documents
  - Medications and essentials
  - Reusable water bottle
  - Additional tips on checking with the program, packing light, and being prepared for varying temperatures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a reliable power adapter for Japan, specifically Type A, and suggested brands:
  - Eagle Creek
  - REI Co-op
  - TravelMate
  - Anker
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided features to look for in a power adapter, including built-in fuse, multiple USB ports, compact design, and high-power capacity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised checking the voltage (100V) and frequency (50Hz) in Japan and not to overload the adapter.
- [PREFERENCE] User found the packing tips helpful and expressed gladness about submitting their application on time.
